headsups.title: A redirect gives every old CLI a 401
headsups.ticket_says: AC 3.1: redirect old CLIs to Hub.
headsups.body: Node `fetch` drops `Authorization` on a cross-origin 307/308. The Lambda must proxy: forward the body and the header, and return Hub's answer.

headsups.title: Hub cannot call Bedrock yet
headsups.body: Hub's role has no `bedrock:InvokeModel`. After the cutover every cache miss fails until the deploy-config IAM lands. ACME-2072 needs the same fix.

headsups.title: The AC 4 dev test cannot reach beta
headsups.ticket_says: AC 4: test with a dev Lambda in the legacy account, in `acme-legacy/hub-platform`.
headsups.body: Beta Hub is internal (WARP only), and that repo is frozen. Run the proxy handler locally on WARP against beta Hub; the code goes to `acme-example/hub-platform`.

headsups.title: This move is also a fix
headsups.body: 231k of 390k calls a day hit a skip row cached from an August 401. Copy only `status='success'` rows to Hub, or the stale rows keep hiding examples.

An answer slower than the CLI's 15 s timeout: the CLI keeps the original example.
items.mitigation: Soft fail, and Hub caches the answer, so the next run hits. No work in this ticket.

facts.text: Released CLIs call the raw Function URL `…lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws`, an AWS-owned host name, so DNS cannot move it.
Node `fetch` keeps the body but drops `Authorization` on a cross-origin 307/308; on 301/302 it switches to GET with no body.
Hub's prod IAM role has no Bedrock permission; its policies are sqsConsumer, s3Writer, s3Reader.
In 24 h: 390k calls = 147k cache hits + 5k misses + 231k skip hits. The skip rows come from an AI Gateway 401 in August.
Beta Hub resolves to an internal ingress (100.72.x.x): reachable on WARP only.
The beta CLI has AI enhancement off: `build.beta.mjs` sets `DEFAULT_HUB_LAMBDA_DOCS_ORIGIN: ""`.
The CLI calls with a 15 s timeout and 0 retries, and keeps the original example on any failure.
`hub.acme.example` moves to k8s Hub on 2026-10-17. Until then `acme-legacy/hub-platform` is frozen and schema migrations are not allowed.
facts.source: Wiki: Acme code freeze Oct 2 to Oct 17 2026

facts.text: Hub already serves `POST /v2/registry/ai/enhance-example` with Bedrock `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` (40 s timeout) and `checkUserBelongsToOrg`.
Hub's HPA scales 3–50 pods at 60% CPU.
The Lambda's CDK (`docs-ai.acme.example`) was never deployed: the host does not resolve.

glossary.means: During `acme generate` and `acme docs`, the CLI sends each endpoint's request and response examples to an LLM, which makes them realistic.
Acme Hub: the API the CLI registers APIs and docs with.
A cache row that says "do not enhance this example". The Lambda answers it with no example.
The auth service. It turns an `acme_` org token into the short-lived JWT the CLI sends.
The VPN that reaches Acme's internal hosts, such as beta Hub.
The program-wide move of `hub.acme.example` to k8s Hub on 2026-10-17.
Acme's deploy settings for one service (IAM, scaling, env), in the `deploy-config-*` repos.
Dana Reyes, who filed the ticket and owns its acceptance criteria.
